mapper.sql: id, instance_id, endpoint_key, `mode`, node_port, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: select from platform_middleware_expose where instance_id = #{instanceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by id asc

select e.id, e.instance_id, e.endpoint_key, e.`mode`, e.node_port, e.created_at, e.updated_at from platform_middleware_expose e join platform_middleware_instance i on i.id = e.instance_id where i.cluster_id = #{clusterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and i.deleted_at is null and e.node_port is not null
mapper.insert: insert into platform_middleware_expose (instance_id, endpoint_key, `mode`, node_port, created_at, updated_at) values (#{instanceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{endpointKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{nodePort,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updatedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) on duplicate key update `mode` = values(`mode`), node_port = values(node_port), updated_at = values(updated_at)
mapper.delete: delete from platform_middleware_expose where instance_id = #{instanceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and endpoint_key = #{endpointKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
